results.rationale: There are now exactly seven distinct capped Coke bottles, fulfilling the requested count. The white background and red-and-black bottle design remain, but the bottles are visibly enlarged as well as rearranged. Their overlapping silhouettes, transparent necks and labels form a coherent product image without a clear structural artifact.

The pig's face, feet, cream glaze, white background and grounding shadow are preserved. The large missing left and upper shell is restored as a continuous rounded body with the missing ear, completing the broken container. The ceramic surface, highlights and contours are clean and plausible.
